description: Issue a write whose starting LBA is past the namespace size. A conforming controller rejects it with Generic / LBA Out of Range.

status.root_cause_hint: LBA range starts or extends past the namespace size

injection.stderr: NVMe status: LBA Out of Range: The command references an LBA that exceeds the size of the namespace(0x4080)
injection.notes: start LBA 1099511627776 is far beyond nsze; the transfer never reaches the backing store.

completion_status.root_cause_hint: LBA range starts or extends past the namespace size

error_log_0x01.note: QEMU 10.2 does not populate log page 0x01 — see docs/injection-method.md

after_all.message: available spare and threshold both 0 — device does not report spare
